title.en: Petzold: Minuet in G, hands together
title.tr: Petzold: Sol Majör Menuet, eller birlikte

goal.en: Plays the Minuet in G, BWV Anh. 114, with both hands together at ♩=80.
goal.tr: Sol Majör Menuet'i (BWV Anh. 114) iki el birlikte ♩=80'de çalar.

explanation.en: Now the melody and the bass line meet. On many beats both hands start a note together.
explanation.tr: Şimdi ezgi ile bas çizgisi buluşur. Birçok vuruşta iki el aynı anda nota başlatır.

explanation.en: Join the hands two bars at a time, slowly. Read the bass note first: it shows where the bar begins.
explanation.tr: Elleri ikişer ölçü, yavaşça birleştir. Önce bas notasını oku: ölçünün nerede başladığını gösterir.

explanation.en: Keep the right hand a little louder than the left. The melody leads; the bass supports it.
explanation.tr: Sağ eli soldan biraz daha güçlü tut. Ezgi önde gider, bas onu taşır.

explanation.en: Where the left hand holds a long note, keep counting it while the right hand moves.
explanation.tr: Sol el uzun bir nota tutarken, sağ el hareket ederken o notayı saymayı sürdür.

explanation.en: The microphone result here is experimental: it does not lock your progress. With a MIDI keyboard the result is exact.
explanation.tr: Buradaki mikrofon sonucu deneyseldir: ilerlemeni kilitlemez. MIDI klavyeyle sonuç kesindir.

brief.en: The Minuet in G, both hands, from the Ostinato edition, piano synthesis, at ♩=80 and at ♩=56.
brief.tr: Ostinato düzenlemesinden Sol Majör Menuet, iki el, piyano sentezi, ♩=80 ve ♩=56.

task.en: Join the hands two bars at a time at ♩=56. Then play the whole minuet hands together at ♩=80, without the repeats.
task.tr: Elleri ♩=56'da ikişer ölçü birleştir. Sonra menuetin tamamını tekrarlar olmadan eller birlikte ♩=80'de çal.

selfCheck.en: Notes meant to start together started together.
selfCheck.tr: Birlikte başlaması gereken notalar birlikte başladı.

selfCheck.en: The melody stayed louder than the bass.
I kept going after a slip.
My shoulders and wrists stayed loose.

fix.en: The right hand runs ahead of the bass. Play the two bars around the slip at ♩=50 and listen for the bass on each "1".
fix.tr: Sağ el basın önüne geçiyor. Kaçışın çevresindeki iki ölçüyü ♩=50'de çal ve her "1"de bası dinle.

fix.en: Find a quieter spot and keep the phone about an arm's length away.
fix.tr: Daha sessiz bir yer bul ve telefonu yaklaşık bir kol boyu uzakta tut.

adaptation.en: Play the first eight bars hands together at ♩=60, then add the rest.
adaptation.tr: İlk sekiz ölçüyü eller birlikte ♩=60'ta çal, sonra kalanı ekle.

repertoire: Christian Petzold (1677–1733), Menuet in G major, BWV Anh. 114, from the Notenbüchlein für Anna Magdalena Bach (1725); long attributed to J. S. Bach. Both hands, bars 1–32 without repeats: the right hand of pno-s3-m14-04 and the left hand of pno-s3-m14-05; each note start is written once and notes starting together are joined with '/'. Bar 1's left-hand chord is reduced to G3 and bar 32's right-hand chord to G4 (Ostinato edition); mordents and the bar-8 appoggiatura are left out. Source edition: Johann Sebastian Bachs Notenbüchlein für Anna Magdalena Bach (1725), preface by Richard Batka, München: G. D. W. Callwey, 1906, p. 44, "Menuet"; scan: University of Toronto Faculty of Music Library, https://archive.org/details/31761108662891 (PDF page 52). Every bar was checked twice against the scan. Public domain: the music dates from 1725; the edition was published in 1906 (before 1931) and Batka died in 1922. Legal review pending. Notation, fingering and tempo by Ostinato.
